note: Patients with 19p13.12 microdeletions encompassing BRD4 present with contiguous gene syndromes that may alter feature frequencies compared to isolated BRD4 point mutations.

evidence.text: Interstitial deletions of 19p spanning BRD4 share core dysmorphic features with point mutation carriers, including synophrys and microcephaly, but produce a contiguous gene syndrome due to the involvement of flanking genes.

source.title: Confirmation of BRD4 haploinsufficiency role in Cornelia de Lange–like phenotype and delineation of a 19p13.12p13.11 gene contiguous syndrome
source.quote: Patients harboring a 19p interstitial deletion shared some physical features with BRD4 mutation carriers, which results in a more complex phenotype because of the involvement of several neighboring genes.

evidence.text: A 1.4 Mb 19p13.11-p13.12 microdeletion patient presented with intellectual disability, microcephaly, and synophrys, refining the minimal critical region for synophrys to a 305 kb interval containing seven genes.

source.title: A case of microdeletion of 19p13 with intellectual disability, ...
source.quote: We present a de novo 1.4 Mb deletion of chromosome 19p13.11-p13.12 in a 16 year old boy with intellectual disability, autistic features, microcephaly, hearing impairment, hypertrichosis, synophrys, protruding front teeth, and other dysmorphic features.
